Name: Willy Sells All Community Center Fishes
Author: MortaliB
Description:
Fishing is usually fun and relaxing but sometimes, you prefer to do other things. If that sounds like you, this mod will help you


[i]All fish sold in Willy's costs x2 times the price you sell them for[/i]

You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url] for this mod to work
